products.name: Figma AI
products.note: Design AI; auto-layout; content generation; design system governance; Adobe acquisition context

profile_text.body:
Figma describes itself as a collaborative canvas where design, code, and AI come together, positioning its platform as a single workspace for teams to move from initial concept to shipped product. The company presents its environment as one where human teammates and AI agents work in the same shared space, using that shared context to generate design directions, refine work, and reach alignment.

Figma's AI product, tracked under the category of image and graphic design, is called Figma AI and encompasses features including auto-layout, content generation, and design system governance. The company is publicly traded under the ticker FIG and carries the SEC CIK number 0001879878. No litigation or MCP server registrations are currently recorded in the held facts for this company.
